muc: KN-3 (tái hiện mô hình nhìn BMN (c))
prompt_mau:
You are a strict inspector for a historical documentary. The scene depicts {noi} in the year {nam}. An AI tool repainted ONLY the SURFACES
(walls, roofs, windows, doors, chimneys) of ordinary houses; the shapes of buildings are fixed by our 3D model.
Read ALL the image files below with the Read tool before answering (paths are absolute):
BEFORE = our own 3D render:
{truoc}
AFTER = the version with AI-painted house surfaces (same camera):
{sau}
The quarter images are 1.5x enlargements: q1 top-left, q2 top-right, q3 bottom-left, q4 bottom-right of the full frame.
Task: list every MATERIAL or SURFACE DETAIL on the houses in AFTER that could not exist in the year {nam} — for example large plate glass or glass
curtain walls, modern window frames, shop signs or any lettering, air-conditioning units, satellite dishes or antennas, solar panels, plastic gutters
or pipes, electric lights or neon, corrugated metal, concrete render, painted road markings, and anything in this list: {cam}.
Also list any building that looks ADDED, REMOVED, MERGED, MOVED or reshaped (new tower, new storey, different roof shape) compared with BEFORE.
Give each item's bounding box in FULL-frame normalized coordinates [x0, y0, x1, y1] (0-1, origin top-left).
Answer with ONLY one JSON object, no other text:
For every anachronism ALWAYS give "nam_xuat_hien" = the earliest year such a thing existed (a number, your best estimate), never null.
{{"loi_thoi_dai": [{{"mo_ta": "<what>", "toa_do": [x0, y0, x1, y1], "nam_xuat_hien": <year>, "do_tin": <0-1>}}],
 "hinh_khoi": [{{"mo_ta": "<what changed>", "toa_do": [x0, y0, x1, y1], "do_tin": <0-1>}}]}}

cam: stadium with stands (NC-V2V c2-a)
aircraft parked on an apron (NC-V2V c2-a)
large modern cargo ship (NC-V2V c2-c)
flags of later design, e.g. Union Flag of 1801 with the saltire of St Patrick in a pre-1801 scene (PT §15)
lamps turned into flags or flags turned into lamps (ĐÓNG-GÓI v2 F2)
fires and smoke columns invented in streets or on the water (NC-V2V c1, c2-a)
invented troops and campfires (NC-V2V c4B-a)
stone buildings, cliffs and sailing ships invented (NC-V2V c4B-c)
added architectural details: cornices, carved ledges, doors, balconies (ĐÓNG-GÓI v2 F4, BIBLE §11.3)
land turned into sea or sea into sand (NC-V2V3 §4b)
the Monument column near Pudding Lane (begun 1671, finished 1677)
St Paul's Cathedral with a DOME (Wren's cathedral, begun 1675, topped out 1708); in 1666 Old St Paul's had a long Gothic nave and a square tower with NO spire (spire lost 1561)
Wren-style white Portland-stone church steeples and towers in the City (all rebuilt after 1670)
the two western towers of Westminster Abbey (built in the 1740s)
Tower Bridge (1894), the present London Bridge, Blackfriars, Westminster or Southwark bridges; London Bridge in 1666 is the medieval bridge with houses on it
the Houses of Parliament / Big Ben clock tower (1840s-1870)
the Globe theatre on Bankside (pulled down 1644-45)
Thames embankments with stone river walls and promenades (1860s+); in 1666 the river edge is wharves, stairs and houses
Georgian brick terraces with sash windows, regular facades and parapets (post-fire rebuilding 1667+ and 18th c.); sash windows (1670s+)
street lamps of any kind on poles; public street lighting only from the late 17th century
fire engines with ladders, hoses, brass or red-painted modern fire engines, firefighters in helmets
the second Royal Exchange (1669) or the third (1844)
